blockingIssues.description: Unknown-hardware scoring can exceed normalized speed bounds: _normalize_gen_tps_log does not clamp to 1.0, and bandwidth-ratio estimation can produce gen_tps > 200, distorting weighted ranking.
recommend writes profile.json via save_profile(profile) when no profile exists, violating display-only behavior for recommend.
Malformed saved benchmark numeric values can raise uncaught ValueError in scoring path, allowing raw traceback output during recommend.
Port collision handling is incomplete: allocate_ports skips LiteLLM port but does not enforce actual in-use port availability despite helper existing.
Init success summary omits total estimated memory across selected tiers, which is required by the feature/validation contract.
Active stack indicator can be incorrect because matching is catalog-id based and not strict to stack-selected source/quant.
Remote-only stack model rows can be suppressed when a different quant/source of the same catalog model exists locally.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit mission rule that all declared feature skillName values must be invokable in worker runtime, or fallback behavior must be declared up front.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Four recommendation features (scoring-engine, recommend-command, init-command, models-command) report runtime error 'Skill "cli-feature" not found' despite metadata requiring skillName: cli-feature.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance to keep validation-contract examples synchronized with live catalog realities (e.g., recommend no-fit edge case budget values) and keep persisted benchmark schema expectations aligned across code and contract.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews flagged stale zero-fit example (`--budget 1gb`) and mismatch between contract benchmark fields and scoring's expectation of `memory_gb`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update cli-feature skill with concrete Python mocking guidance (patch at import site) and Rich CliRunner width/truncation caveats for CLI output assertions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: models-command review notes significant time spent on patch target and Rich width pitfalls not covered by current skill guidance.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a lightweight execution path in cli-feature for trivial lint-only or import-cleanup fixes to avoid unnecessary heavy workflow overhead.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-scoring-lint review passed cleanly but recorded that full feature workflow is disproportionate for small lint-only patches.

rejectedObservations.observation: Convention gap note that VAL-INIT-012 total-memory output is not asserted in tests
rejectedObservations.reason: feature-specific and already captured as a blocking issue under init-command
